messages:
Anya: heads up, seeing a short 502/504 bump in prod over the last 10m. Can someone point me to the fastest dashboards + recommended alert adjustments? need traces to attach to the incident. :eyes:
Ben: quick pointer — Observability > Errors > Gateway. Dash link: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/errs/gateway-overview :link: Panels to check: 4xx/5xx by route, upstream latency, client_ip heatmap.
Priya: for traces use Jaeger search: https://trace.redwood.internal/search?service=ingress&tag=502. Filter by `request_id`. Click trace -> export curl to reproduce.
Kai: alert tuning suggestion: if this is a short burst, increase `for` to 10m and require sustained window of 2 evals. Example PromQL to evaluate 5xx rate by route: ```sum(rate(http_responses_total{status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) by (route) > 0.005``` adjust the numeric threshold as needed.
oncall-bot: Alert: prod-gateway-5xx-spike fired at 1965012330. Incident INC-8241 created. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.internal/runbooks/gateway-5xx
Anya: thanks. Any quick query to pull sample request_ids for the last 15m so I can jump to traces? also want top client IPs.
Ben: logs query (pseudo): ```| where status >= 500 and status < 600 | summarize count() by request_id, client_ip | sort by count_ desc | limit 50``` or in Prom/LogQL style: `sum by (request_id) (count_over_time({service="ingress",status=~"5.."}[15m]))` then grab top ids and join to traces.
Priya: also check the prefix-cache-timeout panel — 504s sometimes come from upstream cache timeouts not gateway. Dash: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/ingress/cache-timeouts :warning:
Kai: I'll temp-quiet non-critical 4xx alerts for the gateway route for 15m while we investigate. @oncall-bot can you mute rule `gateway-4xx-noise` for 15m?
oncall-bot: Mute applied to `gateway-4xx-noise` by Kai for 15m.
Anya: perfect. Ben/Priya if you can paste 2-3 sample trace ids here I'll attach to the incident. pinging @sre-oncall to watch for any regression after we unmute.
Ben: posting samples: trace-abc123, trace-def456, trace-ghi789 — links: https://trace.redwood.internal/trace/trace-abc123 etc. :thumbsup:
Priya: added dashboard links + suggested PromQL to the incident notes. Recommend after we stabilize we consider raising the alert window to 10m for noisy routes permanently.
Anya: closing the loop — will update pager notes and keep this thread for the postmortem checklist. Thanks all :raised_hands:
